title: Kuching Marathon 2026 Review: Sarawak's Premier Full Marathon at Padang Merdeka
seo_title: Kuching Marathon 2026 Review | KM2026 Sarawak Borneo Race
meta_description: The Kuching Marathon 2026 (KM2026): September 27 at Padang Merdeka, Kuching, Sarawak. 42K, 21K, 10K, 5K from the Kuching Marathon Association — Borneo's premier marathon reviewed.
dek: Set for 27 September 2026 at Padang Merdeka in Kuching, Sarawak — the 'City of Cats' — this Kuching Marathon Association-organised race offers four distances. One of Malaysian Borneo's anchor marathons with strong institutional backing.
verdict: The Kuching Marathon (KM2026) is Sarawak's premier marathon — a Kuching Marathon Association-organised race at Padang Merdeka (Independence Square) in the heart of Borneo's most charming city. Four distances (42K, 21K, 10K, 5K) with high data confidence (reliability 94). Kuching is a genuine destination: the Sarawak River waterfront, the Semenggoh orangutans, and Bako National Park provide world-class pre- and post-race experiences. September in Kuching is the tail of the southwest monsoon — warm and humid but generally drier than the November–February landas season. A must-track for Borneo marathon enthusiasts.

sections.heading: Kuching: Borneo's City of Cats
paragraphs: Kuching is one of Southeast Asia's most underrated cities — a clean, green waterfront city with colonial architecture, world-class food (Sarawak laksa, kolo mee), and easy access to orangutans, national parks, and the Sarawak Cultural Village. [1] Padang Merdeka provides a historic, central start/finish precinct.

sections.heading: Should You Run It?
paragraphs: Sarawak's premier marathon with strong institutional backing. Track for registration. 27 September 2026 at Padang Merdeka, Kuching. [1]

faqs.question: When is the Kuching Marathon 2026?
faqs.answer: 27 September 2026 at Padang Merdeka, Kuching, Sarawak, Malaysia. It offers 42.2K, 21.1K, 10K, and 5K. Registration is listed as not yet announced. Kuching Marathon Association organises the event. Entry costs RM60-RM160. [1]
